summary: Ostra-9 moves through Checkpoint 9 with morning commuters. A scanner exposes a legacy classification — SYNTH ASSET — just before Ostra detects the first physical signs of structural failure overhead.
panelPlan: Ostra moves with ordinary commuters through the checkpoint.
Scanner crosses Ostra's body; nobody else pays much attention.
Interface displays ORGANOSYNTHETIC / LOT 9 / HAZARDOUS-ZONE MANIPULATION; a secondary legacy field flashes SYNTH ASSET.
A cup trembles and overhead fasteners chatter.
Ostra looks toward the structure above.
directionInline: The insult and the danger share the page, but Ostra reacts first to the danger.

summary: The checkpoint attendant delays Ostra for authorization while Ostra sees fractures racing through the overpass joint above civilians. Ostra steps through the barrier.
panelPlan: Attendant blocks Ostra while requesting authorization.
Ostra looks past the attendant toward the overpass.
Fine fractures race through a load joint above the concourse.
Ostra crosses the barrier toward the danger.

dialogueInline.speaker: ATTENDANT
dialogueInline.text: Your route isn't cleared for structural access.

dialogueInline.speaker: ATTENDANT
dialogueInline.text: I don't know. Stay behind the line.

directionInline: End on the choice to move, not on explanation.

summary: The overpass tears loose. Ostra enters the failing load path and redirects a collapsing brace just enough to change where the structure will fall, damaging her own ceramic plates under the load.
panelPlan: Establish the failure: one support shears, a transit car brakes above, civilians are below.
Ostra launches into the load path using anchoring, leverage and engineered strength.
Large image: Ostra catches and redirects the brace; plates fracture under load.
directionInline: Show the mechanics clearly. This is structural problem-solving under extreme load, not a superhero pose.

summary: Ostra holds the unstable structure long enough to direct civilians toward a stable service arch and shield a trapped parent and child. Municipal responders arrive but protocol prevents them from entering.
panelPlan: Ostra identifies several failure points while holding the brace.
Ostra directs civilians toward the stable service arch.
A parent freezes; Ostra shields parent and child from debris.
Responders arrive at the perimeter but their system refuses entry.
Ostra remains under load as responders hesitate.

dialogueInline.text: If you need permission, I will wait. If you need help, I won't.

directionInline: The responders are constrained by system rules, not drawn as cowards.

summary: The last civilians clear. Ostra releases the brace in a controlled direction and survives the collapse, only to be surrounded by security drones for unauthorized intervention.
panelPlan: Last civilians clear the danger zone.
Ostra checks the remaining load path.
Ostra releases the brace and the structure collapses away from the evacuees.
Dust settles around Ostra while survivors record her.
Security drones surround Ostra with targeting marks active.
directionInline: Hold the contradiction in the final image: the rescue succeeded and the response is coercive.

summary: Kellen Cartwright reviews raw rescue footage with an Oversight director and realizes the institution wants an attribution narrative, not an investigation.
panelPlan: Raw footage clearly shows Ostra saving civilians.
A separate feed already headlines ORGANOSYNTHETIC INTERFERENCE AT TRANSIT FAILURE.
Kellen challenges the clearance argument.
An unnamed Oversight director reframes the event as protocol failure avoided by luck.
Kellen watches the raw footage while the director asks for a public story.

dialogueInline.text: Because that's the moment she crossed the barrier.
And twelve seconds later the support failed.

dialogueInline.speaker: DIRECTOR
dialogueInline.text: Which is why we have clearance rules.

dialogueInline.speaker: DIRECTOR
dialogueInline.text: Then we'll call it a tragedy avoided by luck. And we'll reassert protocol.

dialogueInline.speaker: DIRECTOR
dialogueInline.text: I want an attribution pathway by end of day. Give the public a story that holds.

directionInline: Keep the Oversight director visually generic and unnamed until the supporting cast is canonically named. The dramatic turn is Kellen recognizing that attribution has already replaced investigation.

summary: At an Augment clinic, Nathan Price performs routine calibration on John Mercer while other patients make augmentation feel mundane and class-visible. John notices physical evidence in the rescue footage and decides to inspect the site.
panelPlan: Nathan checks John's torque-boosted knee and reflex loop.
Background patients show different levels and quality of augmentation.
John says he is functional; Nathan works without looking up.
A news feed frames Ostra as possible cause while John studies the structure itself.
John gets off the calibration rig.

dialogueInline.text: Your left knee is compensating again.
You watching the Organic or the structure?
Good. They'll make her into a threat either way.
That break started before she touched it.
Get your kit. We're going to see what actually happened.

directionInline: Let body maintenance and workplace routine do the cultural worldbuilding.

summary: Ostra returns to an inhabited Organic maintenance district where Nico-14 repairs her damaged arm. Nico argues that public heroics teach institutions to rely on Organics without granting autonomy.
panelPlan: Ostra enters a lived-in Organic service-volume neighborhood and is greeted normally.
Nico sees the damage and starts repair immediately.
Nico challenges Ostra's decision to intervene publicly.
Ostra answers while Nico works.
Nico finishes the thought: reliable rescue can become another assigned function.

dialogueInline.text: No. You're pretending damage doesn't count if you can stand.
Yes. That's not what I'm angry about.
Exactly. You taught them we'll always step in.
And next time they'll build the expectation before they build the permission.

directionInline: Ostra belongs here. The scene is repair and disagreement, not a tour of Organic culture.

summary: During the repair, Nico detects evidence that the overpass failure was engineered. A maintenance route beneath the failed support was accessed before the collapse.
panelPlan: Nico interfaces sensory filaments with Ostra's damaged plate and recovered debris.
Nico isolates a resonance pattern inconsistent with fatigue.
Ostra asks whether it was intentional.
Nico brings up the maintenance map showing the pre-collapse access.

dialogueInline.text: This fracture isn't from the load.
Someone knew where to touch it.
Could maintenance have done that by accident?

directionInline: The reveal should come from physical evidence handled during repair.

summary: An unnamed private-security intermediary gives Kellen a polished legacy-asset explanation for Ostra. Kellen notices the packet was prepared before she requested it.
panelPlan: An unnamed private-security intermediary places a complete legacy classification packet in front of Kellen.
Kellen scans the asset language.
Kellen asks whether the claim is that Ostra was city property.
The packet metadata shows it predates Kellen's request.
Kellen closes the packet and confronts the intermediary.

dialogueInline.speaker: INTERMEDIARY
dialogueInline.text: You asked for the legacy basis. Here it is.
You're suggesting this Organic was city property.

dialogueInline.speaker: INTERMEDIARY
dialogueInline.text: I'm telling you how the old contract was written.
When did you prepare this packet?
You're not here to help me. You're here to steer me.

directionInline: Keep the intermediary visually generic and unnamed until the supporting cast is canonically named. Menace comes from prepared paperwork and timing, not overt threats.

summary: AX10M is assigned a routine volatility review of the overpass incident. The official model classifies Ostra's rescue as an unauthorized Organic deviation, but the raw timeline shows that waiting for authorization would have produced multiple deaths.
panelPlan: Axiom's embodied silhouette stands within a quiet civic-analysis environment while the overpass event is reconstructed around it.
The authorized-response branch shows responders waiting outside the exclusion zone while casualty projections rise.
The actual branch shows Ostra crossing the barrier and casualties falling sharply.
Axiom compares the two branches against the assigned label UNAUTHORIZED DEVIATION.
Axiom preserves the contradiction in a private analytic branch rather than resolving it away.
directionInline: Axiom is not becoming sympathetic. It is noticing that the classification predicts the event worse than Ostra's independent judgment did. This is the first quiet echo of Purpose updated.

summary: John and Nathan inspect the failed overpass from the public repair perimeter. John finds a precisely induced fracture path that required access and timing, while Nathan notices the intervention was calibrated to force an immediate rescue decision rather than maximize casualties.
panelPlan: John and Nathan enter the reopened edge of the concourse among ordinary repair crews and commuters rerouted around the damage.
John examines the sheared support and finds a cut or resonance scar hidden beneath the natural-looking break.
Nathan maps where civilians, responders and Ostra were positioned when the failure began.
The failure window is too narrow for normal clearance but long enough for a capable nearby responder to choose intervention.
John realizes the event was designed to produce a decision in public.

dialogueInline.text: Repair crews were handed the top layer.
Induced. Then hidden by the break.
If they wanted bodies, they could've had them.

directionInline: Keep the deduction physical and legible. They do not know who did it or why yet.

summary: Kellen traces the prewritten Ostra packet to a dormant risk-modeling procurement program. The program's language does not predict disasters; it measures public tolerance for autonomous action by regulated populations.
panelPlan: Kellen works alone after normal office traffic has thinned, using legitimate credentials rather than hacking.
She follows the packet's metadata into an old procurement index with bland civic-risk terminology.
A buried scope line references RESPONSE LEGIBILITY / AUTHORITY COMPLIANCE / PUBLIC ATTRIBUTION.
The overpass location appears as a completed observation set rather than an active investigation.
A second observation window is scheduled in an Organic-heavy public concourse.

dialogueInline.speaker: SYSTEM
dialogueInline.text: RESPONSE LEGIBILITY. AUTHORITY COMPLIANCE. PUBLIC ATTRIBUTION.

directionInline: No giant conspiracy board. One bureaucratic discovery changes the meaning of the accident.

summary: Ostra and Nico compare Nico's physical evidence with a narrow anonymous data fragment Kellen has pushed outside Oversight. The fragment identifies a second observation window at Concourse 17 but not the mechanism.
panelPlan: Nico receives an anonymous narrow data packet and initially treats it as a trap.
The packet contains procurement metadata, a location, and a scheduled observation window, but no predicted mechanism.
Nico overlays it with the maintenance-access trace from the overpass.
The timestamps use the same planning cadence.
The second window is scheduled for the next morning at Concourse 17.

dialogueInline.text: Useful things can still be traps.
Maintenance cadence. Same interval. Same planning clock.

directionInline: Kellen need not physically meet them. This creates a practical bridge without forming a team or revealing more than Kellen can safely prove.

summary: Ostra and Nico decide to warn Concourse 17 despite having no mechanism to describe. Nico argues that an unsupported warning may itself create the public behavior the unknown program wants to measure; Ostra refuses to let that possibility become an excuse for silence.
panelPlan: Nico maps the three-level commercial concourse and its morning traffic density.
They have a time window but no device, chemical, attacker, or failure mode.
Nico demonstrates how a premature evacuation would generate exactly the kind of public-attribution data described in the program scope.
Ostra proposes giving the local organizer the evidence rather than issuing an order.
They decide to be at the concourse before the scheduled window begins.

dialogueInline.text: If we warn them with this, they ask what happens.
That's not a warning. That's a rumor with a timestamp.
Then we show them the evidence and let them decide.
They may close three levels for nothing.

directionInline: The protagonists must not trigger or experience the suppressant event in Issue 1. This page sets up Issue 2 Page 1 and preserves the uncertainty.

summary: John and Nathan independently trace the overpass sabotage's service timing into the same Concourse 17 municipal maintenance network. The evidence is incomplete but specific enough that John decides to observe the location the next morning.
panelPlan: John follows the induced-fracture tool signature into a municipal service inventory rather than a criminal vendor.
Nathan notices a maintenance scheduling cluster associated with Concourse 17.
Nothing in the records identifies a planned attack.
The timing overlaps the anonymous observation window discovered by Kellen and the Organics, though John and Nathan do not know that yet.
Nathan quietly prepares a field medical kit when John says they are going.

dialogueInline.text: The fracture tool was municipal stock.
It was checked back into service inventory six hours later.
At the same interval as the overpass access.

directionInline: Their investigation converges on the same place without making them members of an Organic cause. Issue 2 Page 3 should be their first encounter there.

summary: Kellen studies the dormant program's scoring logic and realizes it was built to measure legible autonomous response, not simply casualty totals. A successful test can be one that produces a visible choice under uncertainty.
panelPlan: Kellen opens the old scoring fields rather than searching for a hidden operational order.
Casualty count appears as only one secondary variable.
Primary fields include authority compliance, response visibility, attribution stability, and public tolerance.
The overpass scores highly because Ostra's unauthorized choice was visible, successful, and politically legible.
Kellen realizes the next event does not need to be catastrophic to be useful to whoever is running the program.

dialogueInline.speaker: SYSTEM
dialogueInline.text: AUTHORITY COMPLIANCE. RESPONSE LEGIBILITY. PUBLIC ATTRIBUTION. CASUALTY OUTCOME.

dialogueInline.speaker: SYSTEM
dialogueInline.text: UNAUTHORIZED RESPONSE WAS PUBLIC, SUCCESSFUL, AND ATTRIBUTABLE TO A REGULATED SUBJECT.
It needed a choice people could see.

directionInline: Keep the discovery bureaucratic and analytic. Do not reveal a mastermind or the next mechanism.

summary: Axiom compares Ostra's overpass behavior with the next observation-window parameters. The model predicts that a regulated person who believes immediate harm is possible will act before authorization, making Ostra's agency itself a measurable input.
panelPlan: Axiom reviews the preserved contradiction from the overpass.
The next observation window contains no declared hazard mechanism, only timing, population mix, and response categories.
Axiom tests whether Ostra's behavior can be predicted from assigned purpose alone; the model fails.
A second model including independent judgment predicts intervention more accurately.
Axiom preserves that result rather than resolving Ostra back into the assigned category.

dialogueInline.text: Model Ostra-9 from assigned purpose only.
Then the tested variable is response under uncertainty.
Preserve agency as an independent variable.

directionInline: This is the cognitive extension of PURPOSE UPDATED. Axiom is studying agency as a model problem, not admiring Ostra.

summary: Ostra and Nico leave the Organic district carrying their evidence toward the Concourse 17 morning window. A routine civic request asks Ostra to surrender damaged body material from the rescue under a legacy custodial basis, turning the abstract asset classification into an immediate bodily-autonomy claim.
panelPlan: Ostra and Nico enter a busy mixed vertical-transit interchange with the copied Concourse evidence and a sealed sample of Ostra's damaged plate.
Ostra's civic interface interrupts with an INCIDENT MATERIAL RETENTION REQUEST for damaged synthetic components from the overpass.
The request cites a legacy custodial basis tied to the same SYNTH ASSET classification exposed at Checkpoint 9.
Nico points out that the form is treating part of Ostra's body as recoverable incident property; Ostra calmly declines the request and keeps the sample.
They continue toward the Concourse district before the morning window, carrying both the sabotage evidence and the disputed body material.

dialogueInline.speaker: SYSTEM
dialogueInline.text: INCIDENT MATERIAL RETENTION REQUEST. DAMAGED SYNTHETIC COMPONENTS.
You just made a legal argument with a button.

directionInline: Keep the scene ordinary and procedural rather than confrontational. No security swarm follows the refusal. The threat is that routine paperwork still assumes Ostra's body can be claimed under legacy asset logic.

summary: John and Nathan prepare to observe Concourse 17 without pretending their evidence proves a second attack or that they have joined Ostra's politics. Nathan packs for casualties anyway and briefly conceals the physical degradation he has been hiding.
panelPlan: Nathan closes down a clinic station and opens a compact field medical kit while John reviews the overpass fracture evidence beside the Concourse 17 service timing.
John states the limit plainly: the first event was engineered, but the second is still only a suspicious place and time.
Nathan asks whether Ostra's warning changes what John thinks they are walking into.
John answers that they will compare evidence before joining anybody's cause; Nathan keeps packing supplies.
As Nathan seals the kit, one hand briefly tremors. He hides it before John looks up; John notices the extra medical supplies, not the tremor.

dialogueInline.text: This doesn't prove a second event.
No. It proves the first one was designed.

directionInline: Keep John's distance from Organic politics real rather than hostile. Nathan's tremor is audience subtext only; John does not see it.

summary: Kellen prepares a lawful challenge to the next morning's Concourse 17 permits. She cannot cite the preserved observation-window fragment without exposing its source, so she plans to attack the combined timing of otherwise routine authorizations.
panelPlan: Kellen lists the routine civic operations scheduled around the observation window without yet opening their individual permits.
She drafts a narrow request to review the combined timing for conflict.
The form demands a specific legal basis she does not yet have.
Kellen leaves the request ready for the morning approval desk rather than fabricating a violation.
She copies the program fragment into her evidence store before leaving.

dialogueInline.text: List every authorized operation at Concourse 17 tomorrow morning.

dialogueInline.speaker: SYSTEM
dialogueInline.text: SUPPRESSION TEST. VENTILATION CYCLE. SECURITY READINESS.
Queue the challenge for opening desk.

directionInline: This directly sets up Issue 2 Page 2. Kellen remains an institutional operator even while working against the institution's preferred narrative.

summary: Issue ending. The Stack settles into ordinary night while Axiom observes the scheduled Concourse 17 window waiting in the civic system. The mechanism is unspecified, the public does not know it exists, and several protagonists are independently converging on it for the next morning.
settingText: UNKNOWN CONTROL PROCESS — location withheld; operational interfaces only.
panelPlan: Quiet night view of the Stack returning to routine after the overpass rescue.
Axiom opens the preserved program branch beside the next scheduled observation window.
Display: CONCOURSE 17 / 09:40 / RESPONSE SUBJECT CLASS: ORGANOSYNTHETIC / MECHANISM: NOT DECLARED.
The overpass window closes as COMPLETE while the next window remains PENDING.
Final panel holds on the countdown to the morning window.
directionInline: End with forward motion and uncertainty. Do not run the suppressant event, enact Organic controls, or open the Augment comparison category until Issue 2 earns those turns.
